head: 3c5a10cebca9ac15c7d944a68529a316fa4d1ae7
scope: Current CI garden envelope / dependent scene and prepared asset producers only. Independent source contract analysis; no source edits, Git mutation, local checks/tests/builds/probes, new tests/assertions/helpers or publication. No stale-input failure inferred.
summary: Existing envelope+oak export is sufficient for those outputs only. A changed hazel hull reaches garden siting, validation and coupled city packing. Minimal source-closed scene selector set is garden-review, massive-city and compound-review, followed by prepared city/layout+furniture. City cloud pixels+digest require refresh if raw massive-city/environment identity changes.

facts.contract: Every world_hull reads the current compiled-in specimen hull, scales/rotates/translates it. CityGarden serializes placement fields, not a frozen hull/envelope version. Envelope geometry_revision is not a placement admission guard. Embedded include_str plus LazyLock will not reload a newly written envelope inside an already-running process; later commands must compile/run against the new file.

Current hull participates in planted bounds, bed/access/wind clearance, pair overlap and building clearance. SceneInput load/digest/grounding validate through validate_source→urban::validate→gardens::validate→validate_geometry. New hull can invalidate a previously stored pose, but none was executed or proven to fail.

Fresh city compilation uses envelope-driven garden admission, retains gardens only if they clear every building, adds kitchen-garden yards, then passes current plant polygons into neighboring-property translation constraints. This is a generation dependency beyond direct garden serialization.

Existing --fixture accepts ONE exact name, filters before build_fixture and writes only changed bytes after validation. --check instead compares generated bytes. Only GardenReview, MassiveCity and CompoundReview paths compile CitySite. Other dispatch paths produce no garden layout and support::declare_catalogue_properties does not create gardens. Do not repeat --fixture flags expecting a multi-select: parser takes first following argument.

garden-review selects and normalizes an actual newly compiled garden, plus distant clone. compound-review compiles a city before isolating compounds and returns no gardens; coupled packing still reaches its source city. Local normalization may cancel translations and leave its bytes unchanged, but independence/byte equality is not established. Including this single transitive selector closes that source dependency without exporting all29.

Prepared city freshly compiles30000 residents at city seed47114, using massive-city input as source/operator identity bank, overwrites layout/gardens, rebinds grounding, generates furniture and writes city-layout.json and city-furniture.json together. It is not a copy of the40000-resident massive-city layout. New packing/garden decisions can affect both outputs; accept both only after example succeeds.

district::curate installs cached layout incl gardens and validates; it cannot resite/rebuild stale accepted poses at runtime. prepare_input first computes raw fixture digest, before city curation. Cloud fixture_environment then calls prepare_input so stale raw or cached gardens can block exporter setup. Cloud digest is based on massive-city fixture forCity, sparse-woodland fixture forOak, not cached city-layout bytes.

Cloud seed derives from scene_digest plus period/latitude/longitude. If raw massive-city serialized data changes, refresh both city.rgba8 and city.scene-digest even if weather is unchanged. If only prepared city changes and raw massive-city/environment remains identical, no cloud identity change follows from that alone. Existing ignored cloud exporter has no exhibit selector: it always processes Oak andCity. No narrower existing cloud generator was found.

direct_membership.all_other_tactical_json: No stored gardens at pinned head; this does not alone establish independence of generator code.

minimal_refresh_sequence.operation: Existing managed-hazel envelope exporter with FABELGEIST_UPDATE_GARDEN_SPECIMEN=1
minimal_refresh_sequence.order: First; review actual new hull/count/bounds. No assertion the output necessarily changes each field.

minimal_refresh_sequence.operation: Existing core generator, one invocation per exact --fixture selector
minimal_refresh_sequence.order: After new envelope is compiled in. These three are independent of one another; preserve single-owner bounded reproduce/fix/check loop. Write only actual changed outputs.
After refreshed massive-city (source data/operator lookup) and new envelope. Copy both only after successful complete generation.

Needed if rawCity/Oak input/environment identity changes; after prepared city because prepare_input validates curated city first. Current helper always rebakes both pairs; no new helper/selector requested. Retain byte-identical outputs unchanged.
Required by changed shoot geometry/replay revision independently of hazel envelope/city. It uses Oak source only; no dependency on refreshed city or hazel file identified.

not_a_repair: --support-source copies current gardens rather than recompiling their admission/siting, then validates before grounding. It is not an equivalent remedy for hull-invalid poses.
acceptance_qualification: Current exporter40242912915 remains pending evidence; it did not include dependent refresh stages.
Only an actual new exported hull and existing receiver/generator results establish which values or files must change; no current pose failure proved by this review.
Generated files after a failed command may be stale/partial; verify source revision and every required exporter success before copying.

Existing non-update hazel envelope case, selected --check comparisons where appropriate, core garden/input/grounding cells, art_demo district/scenery cells and final normal quality remain authoritative. No new tests/assertions or acceptance waiver.
No full774/780/826 audit coverage or runtime/rendered result claimed.

portability_qualification_and_existing_w.purpose: Focused Windows acceptance for the same committed artifacts and expected snapshots after Linux regeneration, without a full second workspace matrix.
portability_qualification_and_existing_w.native_hash_qualification: TreeShootId is now derived from deterministic source seeds before float geometry; however tree_source_geometry_hash still hashes branch start/end/radius f32 bits and leaf petiole/centre/length/width f32 bits. Only identity itself is now lossless u64 input. This establishes stable identity, not bitexact cross-platform geometry or prepared-cache compatibility. Source review does not establish either a current Windows cache failure or portability success.

existing_filters.contract: Three-species full/sparse geometry budgets plus byte/order-invariant sparse meshes.
Actual shared native hazel render geometry must fit committed hull/bounds, count and hull tolerance; export env flag must be absent.

Actual seed42 oak source finite geometry and terminal membership; alpha/textured topology, exact3/4 detailed subset, repeat/reverse-order identity/ordinal equality and shadow selector stability/distribution.
Existing32-shoot fixture retains one coarse sample per shoot, deterministic order and ordinal spatial spread.

Existing asset decodes6 bakes; current site/runtime variant/species source hash matches all4 playable LODs plus both oak/beech vista bakes. Native coordinates/radii/leaf geometry bits remain fingerprint inputs.

optional_related_asset_receiver.reason: If cloud pairs are refreshed, existing case checks both raw fixture digests, complete byte length and nonempty payload; no full ray-by-ray or rendered equivalence proof.

execution_constraints: Use native Windows target at the exact final source+artifact commit, keeping identical expected assets and assertions used for Linux.
Do not set FABELGEIST_UPDATE_GARDEN_SPECIMEN, do not use ignored exporter cases as acceptance, and do not introduce platform-specific snapshots/thresholds/fallback.
Record source revision and real nonempty successful case counts; existing result-cell guards can distinguish a genuine run from an empty filtered run.
No local execution was performed by reviewer. Corrected export and later Linux/Windows authoritative results remain root-owned and pending.
These cases cover only their current authored species/seeds/sites; no renderer/browser, all-seed, all-platform or full774 clearance.
